source_id: BW-PC-01 — TPO publication and eligible Student application; PC-BR-001, PC-BR-002, PC-BR-003, PC-BR-004, PC-BR-005
purpose: Exercise the TPO-managed publication path through an eligible Student application.
preconditions: A TPO is authorized. A Student has a complete profile if profile completeness is required and meets the posting's recorded eligibility criteria.
action_or_input: The TPO submits a posting with valid required content and chooses Publish. The Student applies to the published opportunity.
expected_result: The opportunity becomes Published. The Student's application is recorded as Applied.

source_id: BW-PC-02 — direct Company publication and eligible Student application; PC-BR-001, PC-BR-002, PC-BR-003, PC-BR-004, PC-BR-006
purpose: Exercise the direct Company publication path through an eligible Student application.
preconditions: A Company/Recruiter is authorized to publish directly. A Student has a complete profile if profile completeness is required and meets the posting's recorded eligibility criteria.
action_or_input: The Company/Recruiter submits a posting with valid required content and chooses Direct Publish. The Student applies to the published opportunity.
expected_result: The opportunity becomes Published. The Student's application is recorded as Applied.

source_id: BW-PC-03 — Company submission via TPO and eligible Student application; PC-BR-001, PC-BR-002, PC-BR-003, PC-BR-004, PC-BR-005, PC-BR-006
purpose: Exercise the Company submit-for-TPO path through TPO publication and Student application.
preconditions: The Company/Recruiter and TPO are authorized. A Student has a complete profile if profile completeness is required and meets the posting's recorded eligibility criteria.
action_or_input: The Company/Recruiter submits a posting with valid required content using the submit-for-TPO outcome. The TPO publishes the valid submitted posting. The Student applies.
expected_result: The posting first becomes Opportunity Submitted, then Opportunity Published. The Student's application is recorded as Applied.

source_id: BW-PC-04 — Applied application to Company/Recruiter shortlist; PC-BR-001, PC-BR-002, PC-BR-009, PC-BR-030
preconditions: A valid opportunity is Published, and a Student meets its eligibility criteria and profile-completeness condition if required.
action_or_input: The Student applies. The Company/Recruiter reviews the application belonging to its opportunity and records the Shortlist outcome.
expected_result: The application is recorded first as Applied and then as Shortlisted.

source_id: BW-PC-05 — Company shortlist to TPO-coordinated interview; PC-BR-009, PC-BR-011, PC-BR-012, PC-BR-030
purpose: Exercise TPO-coordinated interview scheduling after Company shortlisting.
preconditions: An application for a Company opportunity is Applied. The TPO is authorized.
action_or_input: The Company/Recruiter records the Shortlist outcome. The TPO schedules an interview with complete details: date, time slot, and online or offline mode.
expected_result: The application becomes Shortlisted, then Interview Scheduled.

source_id: BW-PC-06 — Student application to Company-scheduled interview; PC-BR-001, PC-BR-002, PC-BR-009, PC-BR-011, PC-BR-012, PC-BR-030
purpose: Exercise Company-led interview scheduling after an eligible application and shortlist.
preconditions: A Company opportunity is Published. A Student meets its eligibility criteria and profile-completeness condition if required. The Company/Recruiter is authorized for the resulting application.
action_or_input: The Student applies. The Company/Recruiter records the Shortlist outcome and schedules an interview with complete details: date, time slot, and online or offline mode.
expected_result: The application becomes Applied, then Shortlisted, then Interview Scheduled.

source_id: BW-PC-07 — offer extension from Interview Scheduled and Student acceptance with placement update; PC-BR-009, PC-BR-013, PC-BR-014, PC-BR-015, PC-BR-030
purpose: Exercise offer extension from an Interview Scheduled application and acceptance within the represented deadline.
preconditions: An application is Interview Scheduled. The Company/Recruiter is authorized for the application, and an offer-response deadline is represented.
action_or_input: The Company/Recruiter extends the offer. Before the represented deadline, the Student accepts.
expected_result: The offer becomes Offer Extended, then Offer Accepted. The placement record is updated.

source_id: BW-PC-08 — offer extension from Shortlisted and Student rejection; PC-BR-009, PC-BR-013, PC-BR-015, PC-BR-030
purpose: Exercise offer extension directly from a Shortlisted application and rejection within the represented deadline.
preconditions: An application is Shortlisted and has not been scheduled for interview. The Company/Recruiter is authorized for the application, and an offer-response deadline is represented.
action_or_input: The Company/Recruiter extends the offer. Before the represented deadline, the Student rejects it.
expected_result: The offer becomes Offer Extended, then Offer Rejected.
